build_boot_prompt: build a boot prompt string from BOOT.md content by wrapping it in system-level startup instructions
run_boot_agent: run a one-shot AI agent session to execute boot instructions from BOOT.md content
handle_boot_hook: handle the gateway startup hook by reading BOOT.md and launching the boot agent in a background thread
create_boot_md: create a ~/.hermes/BOOT.md file with startup checklist instructions for the agent to execute on gateway restart
test_boot_hook: test the boot hook handler with a sample BOOT.md file and verify background agent execution
